title_zh: 小米 18 Pro 系列发布，平板、穿戴与三筒洗衣机同场上新
content_zh:
小米昨晚发布 18 Pro、18 Pro Max 两款手机，并带来平板 9 系列、Watch S5 41mm 和 Watch S5 透明版。主要产品与版本信息如下：

小米称，18 Pro 系列的「传奇一瞬」影像功能提供端侧相机风格和云端处理，背屏首批有超过 100 款应用卡。

🔗 相关阅读：小米 18 Pro Max 首发评测：最好的小米手机，也是最好玩的小米手机
title_en: Xiaomi Launches 18 Pro Series Alongside New Tablets, Wearables, and Smart Appliances
content_en:
Xiaomi has officially unveiled its latest flagship smartphones, the Xiaomi 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max. Alongside the new phones, the company introduced several ecosystem products, including the Xiaomi Pad 9 series, the Watch S5 (41mm), and a transparent edition of the Watch S5.

A key highlight of the Xiaomi 18 Pro series is its "Legendary Moment" imaging feature, which combines on-device camera styles with cloud-based processing. Additionally, the devices feature a rear display that supports over 100 application cards at launch, enhancing multitasking and quick-access capabilities.

title_zh: DeepSeek 发新论文，公开 Agent 训练沙箱 DSec
content_zh:
DeepSeek 近日公开了内部 Agent 训练与评测使用的沙箱基础设施 DSec。论文于 9 月 19 日提交至 arXiv，梁文锋列在作者名单中。它介绍的是已投入生产的运行平台，并非新模型发布。

Agent 在训练中需要打开代码仓库、执行命令和调用工具，每次任务都要有可持续保存状态的独立环境。DSec 通过统一的 SDK 提供函数调用、容器、微型虚拟机和完整虚拟机四种沙箱后端，并按任务选择隔离方式。平台还从分布式文件系统按需载入镜像，减少环境启动时的集中下载压力。

论文称，一个约有 160 台节点的生产单元每天处理约 300 万个沙箱实例。生产环境的峰值并发超过 38 万个，每秒可创建超过 5000 个；DeepSeek V3.2 至 V4.1 的强化学习训练与评测沙箱任务均运行在 DSec 上。这些规模与性能数字来自团队的系统报告，尚非第三方独立测量。
title_en: DeepSeek Unveils DSec, Its Production-Scale Sandbox Infrastructure for AI Agent Training
content_en:
DeepSeek has published a new paper on arXiv detailing DSec, its internal sandbox infrastructure designed for training and evaluating AI Agents. Rather than introducing a new AI model, the paper focuses on this active, production-ready platform.

AI Agents require isolated, stateful environments to open code repositories, execute commands, and call tools. DSec addresses this by offering four sandbox backends—function calls, containers, micro-virtual machines (micro-VMs), and full VMs—managed through a unified SDK. The platform also utilizes a distributed file system to load images on demand, mitigating network congestion during environment initialization.

According to the paper, a production unit of approximately 160 nodes processes around 3 million sandbox instances daily. The platform handles peak concurrency of over 380,000 instances and can spin up more than 5,000 new sandboxes per second. DeepSeek's reinforcement learning training and evaluation tasks for models ranging from V3.2 to V4.1 are all powered by DSec.

title_zh: iOS 27.2 Beta 2 加入运动数据限制，可阻止「摇一摇」广告跳转
content_zh:
据爱范儿/APPSO 实测，iOS 27.2 Beta 2 在国区 Apple 账户下新增了一个名为「Restrict Motion Data」的设置。

该版本中，在「设置—隐私与安全—运动与健身」中选择应用，可限制其读取加速度计和陀螺仪等运动数据。被限制的应用无法再用手机晃动触发开屏广告跳转；普通开屏广告和点击、上滑等其他交互仍会出现。

值得注意的是，这项设置跟随 App Store 登录的账户区域，而非手机销售地区。切换到非中国区账户后，入口和此前设置的应用名单会消失。
title_en: iOS 27.2 Beta 2 Introduces Motion Data Restrictions to Block "Shake-to-Redirect" Ads
content_en:
The latest iOS 27.2 Beta 2 update introduces a new privacy feature called "Restrict Motion Data" for users with China-region Apple accounts. This setting aims to combat the highly unpopular "shake-to-redirect" splash ads prevalent in many Chinese mobile applications.

Located under "Settings > Privacy & Security > Motion & Fitness," the feature allows users to block specific apps from accessing accelerometer and gyroscope data. Once restricted, these apps can no longer trigger automatic redirects to third-party platforms when the user accidentally shakes their phone. However, standard splash ads and other interactive elements, such as taps or swipes, will remain unaffected.

Notably, this feature is tied to the region of the App Store account currently logged into the device, rather than the physical region where the iPhone was purchased. Switching to a non-China App Store account will cause the setting and the configured app list to disappear.

title_zh: 蔚来 ES9 交付达 3 万台，用时 119 天
content_zh:
蔚来创始人李斌宣布，ES9 已交付第 3 万台新车，从上市到达成这一节点用时 119 天。交车仪式在苏州举行；蔚来称，这继续刷新了中国高端纯电车型在相应价位段的交付速度纪录。

ES9 于今年 5 月底上市，是蔚来的旗舰纯电 SUV。产品采用全域 900V 高压架构、线控转向和带主动悬架的天行底盘。相较早前的上市参数，此次新的信息是累计交付量与达成时间。
title_en: NIO Delivers 30,000th ES9 Flagship SUV in Record 119 Days
content_en:
NIO has officially delivered its 30,000th ES9, reaching the milestone in just 119 days since its launch. The delivery ceremony was held in Suzhou, Jiangsu province. According to NIO, this achievement sets a new delivery speed record for premium electric vehicles within its price segment in China.

Launched in late May this year, the ES9 is NIO's flagship all-electric SUV. The vehicle is built on a full-domain 900V high-voltage architecture and features advanced technologies, including steer-by-wire and the SkyRide chassis with active suspension.

title_zh: iPhone 18 Pro 用户反映夜景照片出现「绿影」
content_zh:
多名 iPhone 18 Pro 系列用户近日在社交平台发布夜景照片，画面中的高亮物体附近出现绿色斑块或光晕。

据界面新闻报道，这种现象在暗光、暖光环境和部分高焦段拍摄时更明显；有用户称预览画面正常，成片或视频却出现绿影。

界面新闻以消费者身份咨询苹果客服，得到的答复是目前尚未接到相关问题反馈，官网也没有相关公告。影视飓风创始人潘天鸿在评测中指出，主摄可变光圈完全打开时会出现明显炫光。另有摄影类公众号把用户照片中的绿影归因于镜片炫光；这一判断尚不能证明所有反馈都源于同一原因。
title_en: iPhone 18 Pro Users Report "Green Ghosting" in Night Photos
content_en:
Several iPhone 18 Pro series users have recently taken to social media to report a "green ghosting" or green flare effect in night photos, particularly around bright objects. The issue appears more pronounced in low-light, warm-light environments, and when shooting at higher focal lengths. Some users noted that while the camera preview looks normal, the final photo or video shows the green artifact.

Apple's customer service stated they have not yet received official feedback regarding this issue, and no announcements have been posted on Apple's website. Industry experts and creators suggest the issue could be lens flare, which becomes prominent when the main camera's variable aperture is fully open. However, it remains unconfirmed if lens flare is the sole cause for all reported cases.

title_zh: 微软向 DARPA 开放 Majorana 2 量子系统，支持现场独立评估
content_zh:
微软将在美国马里兰州开设一座量子计算中心，让美国国防高级研究计划局（DARPA）的研究人员直接接触 Majorana 2 芯片和相关量子计算系统。此前，外部研究者只能通过微软在雷德蒙德及欧洲的设施远程访问这套硬件。

现场访问允许 DARPA 使用自有启动序列和测试方法检查设备，不必完全依赖微软提供的接口。DARPA 的评估目标是在 2033 年前判断不同量子计算路线是否具备经济价值，微软则计划在 2029 年前推出商业系统。

Majorana 2 延续微软的拓扑量子计算路线。新中心靠近华盛顿，方便政府研究人员持续验证硬件的稳定性、控制方法和扩展能力，而不是只查看厂商提交的测试结果。
title_en: Microsoft Grants DARPA Direct Access to Majorana 2 Quantum System for Independent Evaluation
content_en:
Microsoft is set to open a new quantum computing center in Maryland, granting researchers from the U.S. Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency (DARPA) direct, on-site access to its Majorana 2 chips and quantum computing systems. Previously, external researchers could only access this hardware remotely through Microsoft's facilities in Redmond and Europe.

This on-site access will allow DARPA to run its own boot sequences and testing methodologies to evaluate the hardware independently, rather than relying solely on Microsoft's pre-configured interfaces. The new facility's proximity to Washington, D.C., will enable government researchers to continuously verify the stability, control mechanisms, and scalability of the hardware.

The Majorana 2 system represents Microsoft's continued pursuit of topological quantum computing. DARPA aims to determine the economic viability of various quantum computing approaches by 2033, while Microsoft plans to launch commercial quantum systems by 2029.

title_zh: 闲鱼公布涉未成年人违规引流调查：称站内未发现淫秽信息，已报案
content_zh:
针对媒体曝光的涉未成年人色情引流问题，闲鱼 9 月 23 日通过官方公众号公布自查结果。平台称，多轮排查后，公开展示的商品信息中没有查到淫秽内容，也没有发现涉未成年人的色情信息。对这一结论，仍需等待监管部门的调查结果。

闲鱼在通报中称，报道所涉违规聊天截图来自其他平台，并非闲鱼站内对话；有卖家在站内私聊中通过视频发送站外二维码，引导用户转往其他平台。平台已将相关商家、二维码和聊天记录举报给对应平台，并把报道材料移交公安机关。

闲鱼同时承认，作为引流目标平台负有治理责任，表示将加强关键词识别与人工巡查，并呼吁平台间协同阻断违法引流。通报还称，平台正在跟进公安机关对相关线索的查处结果。
title_en: Xianyu Reports No Obscene Content Found in Minor-Related Traffic Diversion Probe, Contacts Police
content_en:
Alibaba's second-hand trading platform, Xianyu, has released the results of its self-investigation following media reports concerning illicit traffic diversion involving minor-related pornography.

According to the platform's official statement, multiple rounds of internal screening revealed no obscene or minor-related pornographic information within its publicly displayed product listings. However, Xianyu noted that the final conclusion still awaits official regulatory findings.

Xianyu clarified that the controversial chat screenshots featured in media reports originated from other platforms rather than its own interface. It did, however, identify sellers who used private video chats on Xianyu to share external QR codes, steering users to third-party platforms.

In response, Xianyu has reported the involved merchants, QR codes, and chat logs to the respective platforms and handed over the evidence to public security organs. Acknowledging its responsibility to curb illicit traffic diversion, the platform pledged to enhance keyword detection and manual patrols while calling for cross-platform collaboration to block such activities.

title_zh: WPP 在伦敦启用 AI 广告制作中心，先服务可口可乐、联合利华等客户
content_zh:
广告集团 WPP 在伦敦东部启用一座面积约 3.4 万平方英尺的制作中心，整合虚拟拍摄、后期制作、创作者协作和 AI 工具。它是 WPP Production 全球制作网络的首个旗舰中心，首批服务客户包括可口可乐、联合利华和福特。

中心的虚拟制作系统可以在摄影棚内实时更换场景。WPP 展示的案例把一辆福特 Capri 放进巴黎街景，制作团队无需前往当地搭建外景；素材拍摄、编辑和客户审阅也可在同一地点完成。

WPP 希望缩短广告从拍摄到交付的时间，并减少跨地点制作的成本。公司称，这套设施还将用于培训其约 1 万名制作人员，后续会在其他市场复制类似中心。
title_en: WPP Launches AI-Powered Production Hub in London for Coca-Cola, Unilever, and Ford
content_en:
Advertising giant WPP has opened a new 34,000-square-foot production hub in East London, marking the first flagship facility of its global WPP Production network. The state-of-the-art center integrates virtual production, post-production, creator collaboration, and advanced AI tools.

The hub's virtual production system enables real-time background changes within the studio. In a demonstrated case, WPP placed a Ford Capri into a simulated Paris street scene, eliminating the need for the production team to travel or build physical sets. This setup allows filming, editing, and client reviews to take place under one roof.

By streamlining these processes, WPP aims to significantly reduce production costs and accelerate delivery times. The facility will also serve as a training ground for approximately 10,000 of WPP's production staff, with plans to replicate this model in other global markets.

title_zh: 京东方玻璃基封装载板试验线贯通，24 层产品送交客户验证
content_zh:
京东方在 2026 年半年度业绩说明会上披露，玻璃基封装载板试验线已经全线贯通，22 层和 24 层产品已送交客户验证。公司此前已完成 TGV 开孔、深孔填铜、增层和布线等全流程工艺，并向部分国内客户送样。

玻璃基载板主要面向大尺寸算力芯片的先进封装。相比有机材料，玻璃在平整度、热稳定性和高密度布线方面具有潜力，但量产前仍需完成芯片贴装、电性能、信号导通和系统可靠性测试。

京东方表示，希望在 2027 年一季度或上半年达到量产决策条件。当前进展仍处于客户验证阶段，试验线贯通不等于已经进入大规模量产。
title_en: BOE Completes Glass Substrate Pilot Line, Sends 24-Layer Samples for Client Validation
content_en:
Chinese display giant BOE Technology has announced the full operation of its glass-based packaging substrate pilot line, with 22-layer and 24-layer products already sent to clients for verification.

BOE has successfully mastered the entire process, including Through-Glass Via (TGV) drilling, deep-hole copper filling, build-up, and routing. Glass substrates are highly sought after for the advanced packaging of large-scale computing chips. Compared to traditional organic materials, glass offers superior flatness, thermal stability, and high-density routing capabilities.

However, before entering mass production, the technology must undergo rigorous testing for chip mounting, electrical performance, signal integrity, and system reliability. BOE aims to make a formal decision regarding mass production by the first half of 2027, emphasizing that the current pilot line milestone does not yet equate to large-scale commercial manufacturing.

title_zh: 美国调查 Comma.ai 辅助驾驶设备，涉及 5 起碰撞事故
content_zh:
美国国家公路交通安全管理局对 Comma.ai 的后装辅助驾驶设备展开初步调查。监管机构收到 5 起车辆在使用相关设备时撞上同车道慢行或静止车辆的事故报告，其中 2 起事故造成 3 人死亡；另有 4 起事故合计报告最多 11 人受伤。调查针对的是设备及系统表现，现阶段尚不能将所有事故原因归于同一种软件配置。

美国公路交通安全管理局缺陷调查办公室指出，事故报告涉及车辆未能识别或响应前方慢行、静止车辆。部分事故可能使用了 openpilot 的第三方修改版本，这一点也将影响对原版软件与设备责任的判断。Comma.ai 的产品可接管部分车型的自适应巡航与车道居中功能；公司说明仍要求驾驶员随时准备接管车辆。
title_en: US Probes Comma.ai Driver-Assist Systems After Fatal Crashes
content_en:
The U.S. National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) has launched a preliminary investigation into aftermarket driver-assist devices developed by Comma.ai. The probe follows five reported crashes involving vehicles equipped with the technology, which failed to detect or respond to slow-moving or stationary vehicles in their lanes.

According to the NHTSA's Office of Defects Investigation, two of the crashes resulted in three fatalities, while four other incidents left up to 11 people injured. The investigation will evaluate the performance of the devices and systems, though regulators noted that the crashes cannot yet be attributed to a single software configuration.

A key factor in the investigation is whether some of the involved vehicles were running modified, third-party versions of Comma.ai's open-source "openpilot" software, which could complicate liability assessments. Comma.ai's systems are designed to manage adaptive cruise control and lane centering, but the company emphasizes that drivers must remain fully attentive and ready to take control at any time.

title_zh: 💡 李飞飞：AI 安全不能只由开发者自我评估
content_zh:
World Labs CEO、斯坦福大学教授李飞飞在接受 Bloomberg Technology 采访时表示，开发 AI 系统的公司必须做内部评估，但不能成为唯一的安全裁判。她所在的 World Labs 会同时测试模型能力和安全性，行业之外还需要独立机构建立基准，验证厂商没有遗漏或淡化的风险。

她主张把模型评估做成「生态系统层面的责任」。学术界、公共部门、政府、产业界和民间社会都应参与；开放模型与闭源模型也需要放进同一套可比较的讨论框架。李飞飞以自己参与创办的斯坦福以人为本人工智能研究院、语言模型研究中心和更早的 ImageNet 为例，说明独立基准可以在产品发布之前形成公共参照。

谈到前沿模型的发展速度，她没有接受「失控不可避免」的说法。她认为，AI 是影响文明的技术，风险最终取决于人类如何使用、共同治理并承担责任。企业继续开发能力的同时，必须把安全和责任放在研发与部署前线，不能把选择交给宿命论。

李飞飞还把这一原则延伸到 World Labs 的空间智能模型 Atlas。Atlas 生成带有几何结构的 3D、4D 环境，可供设计、机器人、医疗和实验室使用；世界模型能够提供机器人训练和评估环境，但若模拟本身缺少可靠验证，也会把偏差带进物理任务。

她给出的边界是，人类必须保留对目标、部署和治理的控制权。无论工具是语言模型、世界模型，还是电力与交通等通用技术，评价标准都应回到人的尊严、能动性和共同责任。
title_en: Fei-Fei Li: AI Safety Cannot Rely Solely on Developer Self-Assessment
content_en:
AI developers must conduct internal safety evaluations, but they cannot be the sole judges of their own systems, according to Fei-Fei Li, CEO of World Labs and a professor at Stanford University. Speaking in an interview with Bloomberg Technology, Li emphasized the need for independent, external organizations to establish benchmarks that verify risks are not overlooked or downplayed by tech companies.

Li advocated for making model evaluation an "ecosystem-level responsibility" that actively involves academia, the public sector, government, industry, and civil society. She argued that both open-source and closed-source models should be assessed under a unified, comparable framework. Pointing to initiatives she helped create—such as Stanford’s Human-Centered AI Institute (HAI), the Center for Research on Foundation Models, and ImageNet—Li illustrated how independent benchmarks can serve as vital public references before products are released.

Addressing concerns about the rapid pace of frontier AI development, Li rejected the notion that AI is bound to spiral out of control. Instead, she framed AI as a civilizational technology whose risks ultimately depend on human governance and collective responsibility. She urged companies to prioritize safety and accountability in their R&D pipelines rather than resigning to technological fatalism.

This principle also guides World Labs' development of Atlas, a spatial intelligence model that generates geometric 3D and 4D environments for robotics, design, and healthcare. Li warned that if these simulation environments lack reliable, independent validation, they risk introducing biases into real-world physical tasks. Ultimately, she concluded, humans must retain control over the goals, deployment, and governance of AI, keeping human dignity and agency at the center of the technology.

title_zh: 骁龙 X2 携手 Googlebook 进军 Linux
content_zh:
高通在 2026 骁龙峰会上围绕「智能体 AI」带来两项核心发布：正式推出第二代骁龙音频平台至尊版，并同步公布了骁龙 X2 系列 PC 平台的最新生态进展。

音频穿戴方面，第二代骁龙音频平台至尊版专为端侧智能体与多模态交互打造，峰值 AI 算力提升 2 倍至 128 GOPS，平台尺寸缩减 30%，Wi-Fi 状态下空闲模拟功耗降低最高达 40%。

芯片集成超低功耗 Wi-Fi 6E 支持云端直连，搭载第五代自适应 ANC、aptX Lossless 等音频技术，支持开放式耳机、音频眼镜以及配备环境感知摄像头的终端形态。

PC 计算方面，骁龙 X2 系列处理器聚焦终端侧智能体工作流，在 Windows 和与 Google 合作的 Googlebook 基础之上，正式拓展至 Linux 生态，预计今年底前率先支持 Debian，2027 年上半年完成 Ubuntu 认证。

戴尔 XPS Googlebook、惠普 Googlebook 14、本地 AI 推理提速 80% 的微软全新 Surface 系列，以及支持 Linux/Windows 双系统的 HUMAIN Horizon Ultra 等多款 AI PC 新品同步亮相。
title_en: Qualcomm Unveils Snapdragon X2 Linux Support and Next-Gen Audio Platform
content_en:
At the Snapdragon Summit 2026, Qualcomm made two major announcements centered around "Agentic AI": the debut of its second-generation Snapdragon Audio Platform Elite and the latest ecosystem expansion for the Snapdragon X2 PC platform.

Designed for on-device AI agents and multimodal interactions, the new Snapdragon Audio Platform Elite Gen 2 doubles peak AI performance to 128 GOPS while shrinking the physical footprint by 30%. It also reduces idle power consumption by up to 40% under Wi-Fi connectivity. The chip integrates ultra-low-power Wi-Fi 6E for direct cloud connectivity, alongside advanced audio technologies like fifth-generation adaptive ANC and aptX Lossless. It is optimized for open-ear headphones, audio glasses, and devices equipped with environment-sensing cameras.

In the PC segment, Qualcomm is expanding the reach of its Snapdragon X2 processors. In addition to Windows and the Google-partnered "Googlebook" platform, the chipmaker is officially entering the Linux ecosystem. Support for Debian is expected by the end of this year, followed by official Ubuntu certification in the first half of 2027.

A lineup of new AI PCs was also showcased, including the Dell XPS Googlebook, the HP Googlebook 14, and a new Microsoft Surface series boasting an 80% boost in local AI inference speed. Additionally, the dual-boot Linux/Windows HUMAIN Horizon Ultra was introduced, highlighting the platform's expanding versatility.

title_zh: 宾利首款纯电动车 Torcal 亮相，S 版最大功率 888 马力
content_zh:
宾利 9 月 23 日在伦敦发布品牌首款纯电动车 Torcal。这是一款长约 5 米的豪华 SUV，提供标准版与性能版 Torcal S，也是宾利十年来首个全新车系。S 版在弹射起步模式下最大功率 888 马力、峰值扭矩 1350 牛·米，零百加速 2.9 秒。

新车采用 800V 电气架构和 113kWh 电池，官方给出的 WLTP 续航最高约 600 公里。在欧洲的 400kW 充电设备上，电量从 10% 补至 80% 约需 16 分钟。车内保留实体开关，并提供曲面 OLED 屏、可调节座椅及模拟 V8 节奏的行驶声音，后者可以关闭。

Torcal S 是目前动力最强的量产宾利。宾利还为新车提供后轮转向、主动悬架及远程泊车等配置；其中部分辅助驾驶与泊车功能受当地法规和市场供应限制。
title_en: Bentley Unveils Torcal: Its First All-Electric Luxury SUV with Up to 888 HP
content_en:
Bentley has officially unveiled the Torcal in London, marking the luxury brand's first-ever all-electric vehicle and its first entirely new model line in a decade. The five-meter-long luxury SUV will be available in two variants: a standard version and the high-performance Torcal S.

The Torcal S stands out as the most powerful production Bentley to date. Equipped with launch control, it delivers a staggering 888 horsepower and 1,350 Nm of torque, enabling it to sprint from 0 to 100 km/h in just 2.9 seconds.

Built on an 800V electrical architecture, the Torcal features a 113 kWh battery pack, offering a WLTP-rated range of up to 600 kilometers. Utilizing a 400kW fast charger, the vehicle can charge from 10% to 80% in approximately 16 minutes.

Inside, Bentley has retained physical switches alongside modern tech, including a curved OLED display and customizable seats. Drivers can also toggle a simulated V8 engine soundtrack. Advanced driving features include rear-wheel steering, active suspension, and remote parking, though availability of certain driver-assist functions will depend on local regulations.

title_zh: 蚂蚁密算发布「密算一号」，企业可在受控条件下调用云上 AI
content_zh:
在 2026 云栖大会的专题论坛上，蚂蚁密算发布企业级可信智能云服务平台「密算一号」，并启动首批企业定向邀测。平台面向需要跨机构使用数据、将敏感业务资料接入云上 AI 的企业，由蚂蚁密算统一处理参与方接入、权限管理、密态计算环境配置和结果交付。

蚂蚁密算介绍，平台提供跨机构联合分析和建模，参与方无需向合作伙伴交付完整原始数据；企业可按约定获得报告、标签、模型或可调用的数据服务。调用云上大模型和智能体时，密态计算用于限制云平台和模型服务商查看、留存原始业务内容，并保留数据使用范围的审计记录。

平台还可把已验证的数据、规则和流程沉淀为后续可复用的服务，例如持续用于同类业务的理赔核验模型。首批邀测针对有跨机构合作、敏感数据调用和长期数据服务需求的企业，具体接入将结合业务目标与数据条件推进。
title_en: Ant Secret Computing Launches 'Secret Compute No. 1' for Secure Cloud AI Integration
content_en:
At the 2026 Apsara Conference, Ant Secret Computing officially launched "Secret Compute No. 1," an enterprise-grade trusted intelligent cloud service platform. The platform has opened its first round of closed beta testing for selected corporate clients.

Designed for businesses that need to collaborate across organizations or connect sensitive data to cloud-based AI, the platform manages participant access, permissions, confidential computing environments, and final deliverables. It enables secure joint analysis and modeling without requiring partners to share raw, unencrypted data.

When invoking cloud-based large language models (LLMs) and AI agents, the platform's confidential computing technology prevents cloud providers and AI vendors from viewing or retaining original business content. It also maintains strict audit logs of data usage.

Additionally, the platform allows enterprises to package verified data, rules, and workflows into reusable services—such as automated insurance claim verification models. The initial beta is aimed at companies with complex cross-agency collaboration needs and high data privacy standards.

title_zh: 千问发布 Qwen-Audio 3.1，新增音频创作与场景理解模型
content_zh:
千问发布 Qwen-Audio 3.1 语音模型系列，升级语音识别、语音合成和实时对话，并新增 TTS-Next、ASR-Next 两款模型。官方称，系列 API 已陆续上架千问 AI 平台；ASR-Next 的 API 仍待上线。千问同时下调 Qwen-Audio 语音模型价格。

新一代 ASR 模型支持 30 种语言、16 种中文方言，能在转写中标出说话人和时间戳，并对口语中的重复、语气词进行润色。ASR-Next 把识别范围扩展到情绪、环境声和机械声，可描述声音事件的位置与内容。TTS-Next 则可按脚本同时生成人声、音效和环境声，支持多角色音色、时间戳控制与 48kHz 输出。

Realtime 模型支持一边听一边说，用户可以插话或中途修改要求，也能调用外部工具完成查询与任务。千问称，这些能力正用于 Qoder、千问办公以及 AI 眼镜等产品；发布稿中的评测表现属于官方测试结果。
title_en: Alibaba's Qwen Launches Qwen-Audio 3.1 with Advanced Audio Creation and Scene Understanding
content_en:
Alibaba's Qwen has unveiled Qwen-Audio 3.1, a major upgrade to its audio model series featuring enhanced speech recognition, speech synthesis, and real-time dialogue capabilities. Alongside the release, Qwen introduced two new models, TTS-Next and ASR-Next, and announced price cuts for its audio model suite.

The next-generation Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) model supports 30 languages and 16 Chinese dialects. It features speaker diarization, precise timestamps, and the ability to polish spoken transcripts by removing filler words. The advanced ASR-Next model goes further by identifying emotions, ambient sounds, and mechanical noises, providing detailed descriptions of sound events and their locations.

For audio creation, the TTS-Next model can simultaneously generate human speech, sound effects, and ambient noise from a single script. It supports multi-character voice generation, precise timestamp control, and high-fidelity 48kHz audio output.

Additionally, the Realtime model enables full-duplex communication, allowing users to interrupt the AI or change instructions mid-sentence. It can also call external tools to complete tasks. These capabilities are currently being integrated into products like Qoder, Qwen Office, and AI smart glasses.

title_zh: 仓颉编程语言 1.2.0 发布，强化跨平台、编译器与工具链
content_zh:
仓颉编程语言发布 1.2.0 STS 版本，维护周期为 6 个月。新版本继续完善 Windows、Linux 和 HarmonyOS 等平台的开发体验，并升级编译器、包管理、调试与代码检查工具。

这次更新包括编译性能和错误诊断改进，也补充了标准库与跨平台接口。开发者可从官方文档切换到 1.2.0 版本查看发布说明和迁移要求；仍在使用 LTS 版本的项目不必立即升级。

1.2.0 属于短期支持版本，适合需要新能力或提前验证兼容性的团队。生产项目升级前仍需检查第三方库、构建脚本和不同目标平台的行为差异。
title_en: Cangjie Programming Language 1.2.0 Released with Enhanced Cross-Platform Support and Toolchain Upgrades
content_en:
The Cangjie programming language has officially released version 1.2.0, a Short-Term Support (STS) version with a six-month maintenance cycle. This update focuses on optimizing the development experience across Windows, Linux, and HarmonyOS, while delivering key upgrades to its compiler, package manager, debugger, and linter.

Key improvements in this release include enhanced compilation performance, better error diagnostics, and expanded standard libraries and cross-platform interfaces.

As an STS release, version 1.2.0 is ideal for teams looking to leverage new capabilities or verify early compatibility. Projects currently running on the Long-Term Support (LTS) version are not required to upgrade immediately. Developers are advised to review migration requirements and verify third-party libraries and build scripts before upgrading production environments.

title_zh: 豆包工作升级任务模式，新增「目标」与「计划」两种执行方式
content_zh:
豆包工作更新任务模式，新增「目标模式」和「计划模式」。在目标模式中，用户可以给出明确的验收要求，系统会在交付前逐项检查结果；计划模式则先生成可编辑的任务计划，用户确认后再开始执行，适合范围较大或需求还需梳理的工作。

这次更新还加入任务队列、Markdown 文件编辑和深色模式，相关功能已在豆包工作电脑版上线。豆包工作是豆包面向生产力任务推出的 Agent 产品，先前已支持多智能体并行、电脑图形界面操作和本地 Office 文件编辑。
title_en: Doubao Works Upgrades Task Modes, Introducing 'Goal' and 'Plan' Execution Options
content_en:
Doubao Works, the productivity-focused AI Agent platform by Doubao, has rolled out a major update to its task execution system, introducing two new modes: "Goal Mode" and "Plan Mode."

In Goal Mode, users can define specific acceptance criteria, and the system will automatically verify the results item-by-item before final delivery. Plan Mode, designed for larger or less-defined projects, generates an editable task plan for user approval before execution begins.

In addition to these execution modes, the desktop version of Doubao Works now supports task queuing, Markdown file editing, and a system-wide dark mode. These features build upon the platform's existing capabilities, which include multi-agent parallel processing, GUI automation, and local Office document editing.

title_zh: Mirage 发布 Tesseract，让 AI Agent 直接编辑分层视频项目
content_zh:
视频工具公司 Mirage 发布 Tesseract，一套面向 AI Agent 的本地视频创作引擎。用户向 Agent 提供素材和要求后，Agent 可直接操作时间线、图层、关键帧、遮罩、调节层和音轨，生成可继续修改的项目，并在本地预览、渲染和导出。

Mirage 称，Tesseract 使用其 Captions 产品背后的引擎，在 macOS 和 Windows 上运行。引擎本身免费，使用者仍需承担所选 Agent 的订阅或模型费用；官方提供安装指引和接口说明。
title_en: Mirage Launches Tesseract, Enabling AI Agents to Edit Layered Video Projects
content_en:
Video technology company Mirage has unveiled Tesseract, a local video creation engine designed specifically for AI Agents. By providing assets and instructions, users can have AI Agents directly manipulate timelines, layers, keyframes, masks, adjustment layers, and audio tracks to generate fully editable video projects.

Running locally on macOS and Windows, Tesseract utilizes the same underlying engine as Mirage's popular "Captions" product. It supports local previewing, rendering, and exporting, giving users complete control over the creative process.

While the Tesseract engine itself is free to use, users will still need to cover the subscription or API model costs of their chosen AI Agents. Mirage has provided comprehensive installation guides and API documentation to help developers get started.

title_zh: 蚂蚁开源 Ming-Image 设计模型，可生成版式并拆分图层
content_zh:
蚂蚁旗下 inclusionAI 开源 Ming-Image-0.1-Design 与 Ming-Image-0.1-Design-Layer 两款设计模型。前者是 6B 参数的文生图模型，面向 UI、信息图、海报等含文字的视觉设计，并可生成透明背景；后者可以把一张已合成的设计图按要求拆成多个透明图层。

官方模型卡提供了两款模型的权重、推理说明和示例：Design 推荐 1024 或 2048 分辨率，Layer 则接收原图和图层规划，输出独立的 RGBA PNG。两者都采用 MIT 许可证，公开推理代码放在 Ming-Image 仓库。图层拆分让设计师能继续调整文字、元素位置和配色，而不必只在一张扁平图片上修改。
title_en: Ant Group's inclusionAI Open-Sources Ming-Image Models for Layout Generation and Layer Splitting
content_en:
Ant Group's inclusionAI has open-sourced two AI design models under the MIT license: Ming-Image-0.1-Design and Ming-Image-0.1-Design-Layer. These models are designed to streamline workflows for UI designers, graphic artists, and content creators.

Ming-Image-0.1-Design is a 6-billion-parameter text-to-image model tailored for text-integrated visual designs, such as user interfaces, infographics, and posters. It supports transparent background generation and performs best at resolutions of 1024 or 2048.

Meanwhile, Ming-Image-0.1-Design-Layer allows designers to deconstruct a flattened, composite image into multiple transparent RGBA PNG layers based on a specified layout plan. This enables designers to easily adjust text, element positioning, and color schemes without starting from scratch. Both models, along with their weights and inference code, are available on the Ming-Image repository.

title_zh: 阶跃星辰开源 Step Code，支持终端编程与长任务委托
content_zh:
阶跃星辰开放 AI 编程工具 Step Code 的代码。官方仓库显示，它可以在终端读取与修改项目文件、运行测试，并通过交互界面或命令行处理编程任务；代码采用 MIT 许可证。

Step Code 支持 MCP、Agent Skills 和插件，提供可把长期目标交给工具继续推进的 `/goal` 命令，以及按计划触发的 `/cron` 命令。开发者可用 Step Plan 账号或开放平台 API Key 登录，调用所选区域可用的阶跃模型。官方还提供把本地静态网页发布为可访问站点的 StepPage 功能。
title_en: StepFun Open-Sources 'Step Code' AI Programming Tool with Terminal Integration
content_en:
StepFun has open-sourced 'Step Code,' an AI-powered programming tool designed to run directly in the terminal. Released under the MIT license, the tool allows developers to read and modify project files, run tests, and manage coding tasks through an interactive command-line interface.

Step Code supports the Model Context Protocol (MCP), Agent Skills, and various plugins. It introduces advanced automation features, including the `/goal` command for delegating long-term tasks to the AI agent, and the `/cron` command for scheduling automated tasks.

Developers can access the tool using a Step Plan account or an open platform API key to call StepFun's LLMs. Additionally, the tool features 'StepPage,' a utility that allows developers to quickly publish local static web pages into live, accessible websites.

title_zh: 吉利发布 2.25 兆瓦智充站，测试车辆 4 分半补电至 70%
content_zh:
吉利汽车集团发布「吉利智充」技术，同时推出峰值功率 2250kW 的第五代智充站和新一代短刀电池。吉利称，在其实际测试中，领克 10 和极氪 001 所用电池从 10% 充至 70% 用时 4 分 30 秒，充至 97% 用时 8 分 40 秒；这组结果来自指定车辆与充电条件，不能直接套用到所有车型。

智充系统使用吉利与阶跃星辰开发的星睿 PowerMind 能源模型，连接车辆、电池、充电站和电网等环节，提前预测电池温度并调节功率。吉利还提出覆盖储能电池、充电桩、线缆、充电口与车载电池的五点液冷方案。官方称，脉冲修复技术可改善反复快充后的电池循环寿命；新短刀电池峰值充电倍率为 6C。
title_en: Geely Unveils 2.25 MW Smart Charging Station, Charging EVs to 70% in 4.5 Minutes
content_en:
Geely Auto Group has officially launched its 'Geely Smart Charge' technology, showcasing a fifth-generation charging station with a peak output of 2,250 kW (2.25 MW) alongside its next-generation 'Short Blade' battery.

In real-world testing with the Lynk & Co 10 and Zeekr 001, the system successfully charged batteries from 10% to 70% in just 4 minutes and 30 seconds, and reached 97% in 8 minutes and 40 seconds. Geely notes that these results were achieved under specific testing conditions and may vary by vehicle model.

The smart charging system is powered by the 'Xingrui PowerMind' energy model, co-developed with AI startup StepFun. The model connects vehicles, batteries, charging stations, and the power grid to predict battery temperatures and dynamically optimize power distribution. To support these high speeds, Geely introduced a five-point liquid cooling system and pulse repair technology to extend battery life during frequent fast charging. The new Short Blade battery boasts a peak charging rate of 6C.

title_zh: 百威英博调整产品策略，小包装啤酒和功能型无酒精饮品将增多
content_zh:
百威英博将扩大更小和更大包装规格，同时开发加入蛋白质、电解质的无酒精啤酒，以及罐装鸡尾酒和能量饮料。公司称，消费者减少饮酒频率、控制支出和关注健康，正在改变传统啤酒的产品组合。

在巴西，百威英博已经测试 Spaten 蛋白质啤酒；功能型配方则主要面向运动、社交和日常补水场景。小包装可以降低单次购买门槛，大包装用于聚会和家庭消费，两种方向同时存在。

公司还计划让啤酒品牌进入更多非啤酒品类，但不会只依赖新品类增长。核心啤酒业务仍会通过不同容量、低酒精和无酒精版本覆盖更多消费时段。
title_en: AB InBev Shifts Strategy Toward Functional Non-Alcoholic Drinks and Varied Packaging Sizes
content_en:
Anheuser-Busch InBev (AB InBev) is adjusting its product portfolio to adapt to changing consumer habits, focusing on smaller and larger packaging sizes, functional non-alcoholic beers, canned cocktails, and energy drinks. The brewer noted that consumers are drinking less frequently, cutting back on spending, and becoming more health-conscious, which is reshaping the traditional beer market.

In Brazil, the company has already trialed "Spaten" protein beer. These functional beverages, enriched with protein and electrolytes, target sports, social gatherings, and daily hydration. Meanwhile, AB InBev is diversifying its packaging: smaller sizes lower the cost barrier for single purchases, while larger packs cater to parties and home consumption.

While the company plans to extend its beer brands into non-beer categories, it will not rely solely on these new segments for growth. Its core beer business will continue to expand its reach across different consumption occasions through various packaging volumes, as well as low- and non-alcoholic options.

title_zh: Instacart 宣布将接入 Meta Muse，购物清单可转为生鲜订单
content_zh:
生鲜配送平台 Instacart 宣布，计划把自家的购物连接器接入 Meta 的个人 AI Agent Muse。用户可在对话中提出一顿饭或一周的采购需求，由 Instacart 根据所选商店的实时库存与个人偏好生成待结算购物车，再由用户确认购买。

Instacart 已将类似能力接入 ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini 等平台。此次公告确认的是 Muse 即将接入；Meta 9 月初介绍 Muse 时已展示购物和支付场景，但这项生鲜连接器尚未作为已上线功能发布。
title_en: Instacart to Integrate with Meta's AI Agent Muse for Seamless Grocery Ordering
content_en:
Grocery delivery platform Instacart has announced plans to integrate its shopping connector with Meta's personal AI assistant, Muse. This integration will allow users to state their meal plans or weekly grocery needs directly within a chat. Instacart will then generate a ready-to-checkout shopping cart based on real-time store inventory and user preferences, requiring only a final confirmation from the user.

Instacart has already deployed similar capabilities across other major AI platforms, including ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini. While Meta showcased shopping and payment scenarios when introducing Muse in early September, the Instacart grocery connector is not yet live and is marked as an upcoming feature.

title_zh: YouTube 推出 Shorts 连续剧功能，短剧可按季和集播放
content_zh:
YouTube 在 9 月 23 日的 Made on YouTube 活动上宣布推出 Shorts Series，创作者可以把短视频编排成季和集，添加自定义缩略图，观众也能按顺序连续播放。该功能当天开始向创作者推出，覆盖网页、手机和电视端。

YouTube 表示，2026 年上半年平台微短剧的观看次数超过 65 亿次，观看时长同比增长超过 50%；电视端的微短剧观看次数同比增长超过 90%。短视频原本以手机观看为主，这次更新把连续剧式的观看路径带到了大屏。

YouTube 同时为电视端增加语音输入评论功能，用户观看时可直接在电视上发表评论。社区帖子也计划在未来几个月进入电视端。
title_en: YouTube Launches 'Shorts Series' to Enable Episodic Viewing Across Devices
content_en:
At its "Made on YouTube" event on September 23, YouTube announced the launch of "Shorts Series." This new feature allows creators to organize their short-form videos into structured seasons and episodes, complete with custom thumbnails. Audiences can now watch these micro-dramas sequentially across web, mobile, and TV platforms.

The update aims to capitalize on the booming popularity of micro-dramas. According to YouTube, views for these short-form series exceeded 6.5 billion in the first half of the year, with watch time growing by over 50% year-over-year. Notably, views on TV screens surged by more than 90% year-over-year, prompting YouTube to bring this episodic, lean-back viewing experience to larger screens.

In addition to Shorts Series, YouTube is enhancing its TV interface by introducing voice-input commenting, allowing users to dictate comments directly from their screens. The platform also plans to roll out Community posts to TV devices in the coming months.

title_zh: 《活久久》定档 12 月 31 日，张艺凡与陈立农主演
content_zh:
爱情电影《活久久》发布首支预告，并宣布于 12 月 31 日在中国内地上映。影片由陈国辉执导，张艺凡、陈立农领衔主演，林永健、郭柯宇等参演。

预告围绕许倩和乔一泽的婚后生活展开：两人在婚礼上约定相伴，随后共同面对突如其来的考验。影片以一段从病房到旷野、海边的旅程串联两人的故事。
title_en: Romance Film 'Till Love Do Us Part' Starring Zhang Yifan and Chen Linong Sets December 31 Release
content_en:
The upcoming romance film *Till Love Do Us Part* has released its first trailer and officially scheduled its theatrical release in mainland China for December 31.

Directed by Tony Chan, the film stars Zhang Yifan and Chen Linong in the leading roles, alongside a supporting cast that includes Lin Yongjian and Guo Keyu.

The trailer offers a glimpse into the married life of Xu Qian and Qiao Yize. After promising to stand by each other at their wedding, the couple must navigate sudden and unexpected trials. Their emotional journey is captured through a scenic voyage that takes them from a hospital ward to the open wilderness and the seaside.

title_zh: 《雷·冈恩》首曝预告，布拉德·伯德拍未来都市侦探故事
content_zh:
Netflix 发布布拉德·伯德执导的动画电影《雷·冈恩》首支预告。影片设定在复古未来都市 Metropia，人类与外星人共处，山姆·洛克威尔配音的私家侦探雷蒙德·冈恩仍靠实地调查办案；汤姆·威茨配音的独眼外星人 Eye-Ra 是他的搭档。斯嘉丽·约翰逊配音的明星 Venus Nova 卷入案件，将故事引向城市的名流圈与地下世界。

伯德将影片描述为黑色侦探片与科幻冒险的结合，主创从他早年构思的项目发展出这部作品。影片计划 12 月 4 日在部分影院及 70mm 影院限量上映，12 月 18 日上线 Netflix。
title_en: Netflix Debuts First Trailer for Brad Bird’s Sci-Fi Noir Animated Film 'Ray Gunn'
content_en:
Netflix has released the first trailer for *Ray Gunn*, an upcoming animated film directed by Brad Bird. Set in the retro-futuristic metropolis of Metropia, where humans and aliens coexist, the story follows private detective Raymond Gunn (voiced by Sam Rockwell) as he relies on old-school shoe-leather investigation to solve cases.

Gunn is joined by his one-eyed alien partner, Eye-Ra, voiced by Tom Waits. The plot thickens when a high-profile star named Venus Nova (voiced by Scarlett Johansson) becomes entangled in a case, dragging the duo into the city's glamorous high society and its gritty underworld.

Bird describes the film as a blend of film noir detective story and sci-fi adventure, a project developed from an idea he conceived early in his career. *Ray Gunn* is scheduled for a limited theatrical and 70mm release on December 4, followed by its streaming debut on Netflix on December 18.
